latitude.title: Latitude
latitude.description: Center point latitude for a regional search. Leave blank (with longitude) for a worldwide search.

longitude.title: Longitude
longitude.description: Center point longitude for a regional search. Leave blank (with latitude) for a worldwide search.

radiusKm.title: Radius (km)
radiusKm.description: Search radius around the latitude/longitude, in kilometers. Only used if latitude and longitude are both set.

minMagnitude.title: Minimum magnitude
minMagnitude.description: Only return earthquakes at or above this magnitude.

alertLevel.title: PAGER alert level
alertLevel.description: USGS PAGER estimated impact level: green (minimal), yellow, orange, or red (severe). Leave as "all" to skip this filter — most earthquakes have no alert level at all.

daysBack.title: Days back
daysBack.description: How many days back from today to search.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of earthquakes to return, most recent first.
